description: A deleted server column that the UI type still declares reads as `undefined` on the wire, so a `x !== null` guard evaluates TRUE and mounts a component that then dereferences it — blanking the whole SPA when no error boundary is mounted. Hit in warren-1f12: #626-#628 dropped runs.plot_id but RunDetail kept `{r.plotId !== null ? <PlotMetaCardContent plotId={r.plotId}/> : null}`; PlotMetaCardContent did `plotId.length > 0` -> TypeError during render -> React unmounted the root -> every /#/runs/:id was a blank page. src/ui/src/api/types.ts is a HAND-MAINTAINED mirror of the wire shape, so typecheck stayed green and the lie survived. Latency trap: the bad code merged 2026-07-23 but only broke prod 2026-07-25, when a manual workflow_dispatch rolled GKE forward — deploy-gke.yml only auto-deploys on release or a k8s-migration push, so 'main is green' did not mean 'prod is green'.
resolution: Delete the stale UI surface in the same pass as the server column (completed pl-3a79 step 10) and mount a route-level ErrorBoundary INSIDE the Layout chrome so a page throw degrades to one error card with the sidebar intact. Prevention: (1) when dropping a server column, grep src/ui/src/api/types.ts + src/client/types.ts in the SAME PR — those hand-maintained types are the only thing asserting the field exists; (2) guard absent-vs-null with a falsy check, not `!== null`, since absent reads as undefined; (3) src/ui-tests/plot-surface-removed.test.ts pins the absence tree-wide so it cannot drift back.

content: src/ui/src/api/client.ts is the only place the bearer is attached, always as an Authorization header. client.test.ts's wire-path table enforces this per-route — new api methods must be added to that table.

description: Bun fetch on ?follow=1 NDJSON hangs until first body byte
resolution: Seed at least one persisted event before fetching a follow=1 NDJSON route in wire tests

name: operator-only-capability-gate
description: UI capability gating goes through one <OperatorOnly capability> wrapper whose capability prop names the server's RoutePolicy for the route behind it, so the gate and the 403 can't drift; <OperatorRoute> is its route-level twin and bounces to /runs. useCapabilities() treats a 401 as unauthenticated (→ /login), transport failure as a distinct third state so a blip can't demote an operator to read-only.

content: Every wire field a public projection drops must be declared OPTIONAL in src/ui/src/api/types.ts, never T | null. undefined !== null is TRUE — the exact shape that blanked every run-detail page in warren-1f12 — so an optional declaration is what makes the compiler demand a presence test.

A file under src/ui/src exercised by the repo-root bun test must use RELATIVE runtime imports — the root runner resolves no @/ alias (only Vite + tsconfig.app.json do). Type-only @/ imports are fine because verbatimModuleSyntax erases them. Hence the use-capabilities.ts/.helpers.ts split.

description: A docblock explaining a removal quoted the removed key and failed the structural test scanning for it.
resolution: Describe what was removed; don't quote it in comments.

description: A composite tsconfig fails TS6307 on any import outside its own include array
resolution: Add the shared module explicitly to include in src/ui/tsconfig.app.json (e.g. "../core/wire.ts"). Only 'bun run build:ui' catches this — root 'tsc --noEmit' excludes src/ui entirely, so a cross-package import can typecheck green at the root and still fail the UI build.

content: biome.json overrides[1] names the 32 legacy files for useFilenamingConvention. Newer src/ui files already use kebab-case. The list is a ratchet to drain (warren-4e87), not a permanent exemption — do not add to it.

name: effect-dep-is-trigger-not-read
description: Effects whose dep is a re-run TRIGGER rather than a read take a biome-ignore useExhaustiveDependencies with a reason

name: ts7-ui-workspace-migration
description: TS7 migration for src/ui: TypeScript 7 removed baseUrl; paths in tsconfig resolve relative to the tsconfig file, so '@/*': ['src/*'] must become './src/*'. The UI workspace pins its own typescript devDep separately from the root package.json — bumping root (as Dependabot #614 did) does not migrate src/ui. Verify with cd src/ui && bun run typecheck, then check:bundle-size from a fresh node_modules.
